title: CI is in status Ready for too long
cardHint: The CI has been in status Ready for months. Its other problems wait while it is not live, so the owner is asked.
cardText: The CI was created more than the number of days in Settings ago (90 at first) and is still in status Ready. A CI in Ready is not live, so its other problems wait. That is right for a new CI, not for one that sits in Ready for months: clarify it with the owner when there is time. Business Processes and Business Applications are not on this card.

message.subject: In status Ready for a long time
message.intro: They are still in status Ready, long after they were created.
message.ask: Is it in use? Then the status must be Operational. Is it not needed any more? Then it must be retired. Please make the change, or {reply}.

askByClass.service_instance: Is this system in use? Then its status must be Operational. Is it not needed any more? Then it must be retired. Please make the change in EPO, or {reply}.

message.why: A CI in Ready is treated as not live: its owner, criticality and relationships are not followed up.
